name: AR advanced technology,Inc.
summary: AR advanced technology, Inc. is a Japanese firm providing digital transformation solutions that use cloud computing, data analytics and AI. Its products include Meita, a cloud service for running and analyzing contact centers, LOOGUE FAQ, an AI chatbot for handling employee inquiries, and ZiDOMA, an integrated file server management solution. Dating from 2010, it has its base in Shibuya, Japan.
